VBO:0200423.summary: Wire-haired Dachshunds can be playful and responsive companions while remaining vigorous, persistent workers outdoors. Digging is part of their hunting inheritance, and their weather-resistant coat was developed for demanding terrain. Their terrier ancestry helped shape the variety, but they still share the Dachshund’s nose-led, above- and below-ground hunting skills.
VBO:0200423.shortDescription: The wire-haired Dachshund often mixes playful companionship with persistent hunting drive and a strong urge to dig.

sources.title: Canadian Kennel Club — Standard Wire-haired Dachshund
sources.evidence: CKC exact wire profile Temperament/Activity level supports vigorous outdoor work, affectionate indoor companionship, responsive playfulness and digging. Origin explicitly records coat weather resistance and terrier influence; no speculative parent-trait inference is added. Standard-size scope is cross-checked with shared DCA temperament and applies to a standard-size representative.

sources.title: Dachshund Club of America — Official Standard
sources.evidence: DCA standard says all coats/both sizes share temperament and general hunting traits; Wirehaired coat section distinguishes hard close coat, beard, eyebrows, short ear hair, wild-boar color and non-flag tapered tail.
